title: 瑞银全球研究主管：芯片自给率提升，科技硬件增长能否持续？
speaker: UBS APAC Global Research Head (name not stated)

segments.en: Exactly. That key question. So the growth of them, of course, is coming from tech.
segments.zh: 没错，关键问题在于，它们的增长当然来自科技。

segments.en: And of course, like hardware, you know, everything is at that.
segments.zh: 当然，像硬件，你知道，一切都集中在那。

segments.en: I think now driving China is another thing that is coming to your point about like the self reliance.
segments.zh: 我认为现在推动中国的另一个因素，正呼应你提到的自主可控。

segments.en: So talking about AI, I mean there's no debate like the demand for AI for chips is definitely there.
segments.zh: 谈到AI，我的意思是，对AI芯片的需求毫无疑问是存在的。

segments.en: Supply constraint is office. I think there's also why leading to the market correction in the last couple of weeks.
segments.zh: 供应限制是主要问题，我认为这也是过去几周市场调整的原因之一。

segments.en: But now with the self reliance coming back, we do some forecasts about like on a medium time basis, let's say going to 2028.
segments.zh: 但现在随着自主可控回归，我们做了一些中期预测，比如到2028年。

segments.en: Our forecast is China will have domestic chips shipment of like 10 million units.
segments.zh: 我们的预测是，中国国内芯片出货量将达到约1000万颗。

segments.en: So which is like a 4.4s of forecast for this year.
segments.zh: 这大约是今年预测的4.4倍。

segments.en: So I guess this domestic balance theme is coming back.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这种国内平衡的主题正在回归。

segments.en: And as a result, tech hardware growth will continue to stay robust.
segments.zh: 因此，科技硬件增长将继续保持强劲。

segments.en: Okay, so you have the strongest conviction in China right now.
segments.zh: 好的，那么你现在对内地市场最有信心。
